# The flake's checks on the Linux CI systems (x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux): the attribute names of
# `checks.<system>`, one per line, plus their literal count (#722).
#
# The ONE list of what a `nix flake check` leg must cover. Two consumers, each failing on any
# difference:
#   - flake.nix asserts at evaluation that `checks` has exactly these names (on Darwin, minus the
#     Linux-only ones), so adding, renaming or removing a check without editing this file fails
#     every `nix flake check`, locally too;
#   - scripts/nix-check-summary.sh (the summary step in nix-check.yml) compares the names CI
#     evaluated against this list, so an evaluation that comes back empty or short turns the leg red
#     instead of reporting "0 passed, 0 failed".
# The count is checked against the names, so a truncated list cannot pass as a shorter one.
count: 29
